memory_bridge: Keep the harvest cycle as a two-turn calendar: the next harvest is 来年 for On ネン, while one year experienced as a span is 年 for Kun とし.

readings.editorial_reason: Promoted because 来年（らいねん）is common, modern, and pedagogically useful.
readings.overlay: Tie a 来年（らいねん） tag to next season’s unripe grain; the compound ends in On ネン and means “next year.”

readings.editorial_reason: Promoted because 年（とし）is common, modern, and pedagogically useful.
readings.overlay: After the person finishes one full harvest cycle, call that span a 年（とし）; the standalone native noun fixes Kun とし, “year.”
